description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart admin mail controller namespace. It contains methods to send approval and denial email notifications to customers for account registration status, loading relevant customer, store, language data, preparing email content, and scheduling email tasks.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class handling customer account approval and denial email notifications within the Opencart admin mail system.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles sending an approval notification email to a customer, gathering required store, language, and customer data, and scheduling the email task.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles sending a denial notification email to a customer with similar data collection and task scheduling as 'approve', but for denial notifications.
